results.description:
A childhood friend of Chris who is likewise attending the music school.

The younger twin of Arietta, she is an active girl with a strong personality. Tortinita is a third year vocalist student of the school, and as such has the option of being able to give a solo performance for her graduation performance. She eats lunch together with Chris in the school cafeteria almost everyday. Her nickname is Torta.

[spoiler]She has liked Chris ever since they were young, but since Chris chose Arietta, she decided to hide her feelings even though she started liking Chris before her sister did. 
After the accident, Chris and Torta's families decided to send them to music school in order to help Chris recuperate.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symphonic_Rain]Wikipedia[/url]]
